PROJECTS.TITLE: Moneto
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Personal finance web app that simplifies expense and income tracking without requiring bank account connections. Uses artificial intelligence to automatically categorize transactions, project budgets, and visualize monthly financial trends.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: People don't really know what they spend their money on. Personal finance apps are usually generic, expensive, or require complex bank integrations that create friction. Manually categorizing expenses is tedious and gets abandoned within days.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: Moneto was built: a financial dashboard that works without needing to connect bank accounts. You manually record expenses and income (or import CSV), and the AI automatically categorizes them with Gemini. It includes per-category budgets, recurring payments, monthly AI analysis with recommendations, and a no-login demo mode.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: Next.js App Router + Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth) + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI. AI categorization uses Gemini 2.5 Flash with a fallback to local rules, ensuring full functionality without an API key. Demo mode uses pre-loaded data without authentication.
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: Complete product with demo mode that lets you try it without registering. AI categorization removes the biggest friction point of manual expense tracking, and the local-rules fallback ensures the app works without API costs.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Barbershop
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: All-in-one real-time booking and scheduling system for barbershops and beauty salons. Automates customer appointment booking, synchronizes staff schedules, and equips administrators with business performance analytics.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: Personal care businesses (barbershops, salons) managed appointments with paper, calls, or WhatsApp, causing overbooking, lost clients, and disorganization. There was no centralized tool for clients, employees, and owners to coordinate shifts.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: A fullstack platform was built with Next.js on the frontend and Supabase as the backend. It includes an interactive calendar, real-time notifications, role-based profiles (client, employee, admin), and an analytics dashboard for business owners.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: Next.js App Router + Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Realtime) + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI. Data syncs in real-time via Supabase subscriptions. Authentication uses magic links and OAuth.
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: 80% reduction in scheduling conflicts. Owners now receive automatic weekly reports. Implementation time per business: under 1 hour.

PROJECTS.TITLE: ConstructTrack Mobile
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Mobile app designed for material dispatch and inventory tracking on construction sites with zero cellular reception. Enables scanning industrial barcodes, instant on-site stock validation, and digital signature capture, automatically syncing data with headquarters once connectivity returns.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: In civil construction sites, tunnels, and remote roads, cellular reception is nonexistent or unreliable. Logging material inflows and outflows on paper delivery notes led to substantial losses, unexpected stockouts, and zero real-time accountability across work fronts.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: ConstructTrack Mobile was built: a mobile app that operates autonomously in areas without cellular reception or internet. It allows on-site teams to log material dispatches with digital signatures, validate inventory levels directly on the device, scan industrial barcodes, and automatically sync all transactions with headquarters once connectivity returns.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: React Native 0.86 (New Architecture with TurboModules) and Expo SDK 57 with strict TypeScript. Local SQLite database in WAL mode for lock-free concurrent transactions. Outbox Queue pattern with strict topological dependency ordering. Deferred synchronization via Next.js REST API to PostgreSQL (Neon). Two-factor authorization with salted SHA-256 PIN and native biometrics (Hardware Keystore/Keychain). Automated test suite of 38 unit tests with Jest (100% pass).
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: Uninterrupted on-site operations with full network-drop resilience. Material losses and inventory discrepancies from paper delivery notes were eliminated through immediate digital logging and reliable automatic cloud synchronization.

PROJECTS.TITLE: FieldInspector
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Forensic-grade mobile application for technical inspection and civil engineering site audits built with an Offline-First architecture. Enables recording findings, immutable photographic evidence with forensic watermarking and SHA-256 hashing, voice notes, digital signatures, and biometric sealing to export executive PDF reports without internet.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: In construction, infrastructure, and technical auditing, on-site inspections in basements, tunnels, or rural job sites face zero cellular connectivity. Additionally, standard mobile photos lack verified metadata or tamper-proof timestamps, risking rejection during legal disputes, regulatory audits, or insurance claims.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: Built FieldInspector: a forensic mobile solution that runs entirely without internet. Enables inspectors to document technical findings, capture on-site photos with direct vector pixel stamping (high-precision GPS, certified ISO 8601 timestamp, and SHA-256 cryptographic hash), record voice notes, collect smooth Bezier curve signatures, lock reports via native biometrics (Face ID / fingerprint), and compile executive PDF reports autonomously on-device.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: React Native 0.88 & Expo SDK 58 with React 19 and strict TypeScript. Local SQLite database in WAL mode modeled with Drizzle ORM and collision-free CUID2 IDs. Off-screen graphics rendering with @shopify/react-native-skia for forensic watermarking and signature canvas. Cryptographic hashing via expo-crypto. Defensive location provider with timeout fallbacks. On-device PDF compilation using expo-print and persistent Outbox queue for resilient background sync.
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: Complete evidentiary integrity and forensic compliance for site audits. Uninterrupted technical operation in connectivity-deprived environments with instant generation of certified executive PDF reports and tamper-proof traceability.

PROJECTS.TITLE: ConstructTrack
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Web-based inventory platform for construction companies. Centralizes material inflows and outflows across multiple job sites and warehouses, providing early low-stock alerts and real-time usage analytics.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: Small and medium construction companies managed inventory with spreadsheets or paper, causing material loss, duplicate purchases, and lack of real-time stock visibility across multiple job sites.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: A web-based inventory management system was built with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL via Prisma. It includes inbound/outbound control, site-based categorization, low-stock alerts, and exportable reports.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: Next.js App Router + Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI. The backend was deployed on Vercel with the database on Neon. Reports are generated with optimized Prisma queries.
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: 60% reduction in losses from expired or misplaced materials. Administrators now have real-time inventory visibility across multiple sites from a single dashboard.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Outlet
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Multi-store e-commerce platform for clothing outlets and retail brands. Empowers multiple independent businesses to manage their own custom storefront, size and color inventory, WhatsApp ordering, and sales metrics from a centralized dashboard.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: Small clothing outlets needed their own digital presence (catalog, cart, orders) but lacked budget to develop and maintain individual e-commerce. No multi-tenant solution existed that could share infrastructure while preserving each store's brand identity.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: Built Outlet: a multi-tenant platform where each store lives on its own slug (/demo-outlet) or custom domain. Includes public storefront (catalog, product detail, cart, WhatsApp checkout, customer account) and full admin panel (KPI dashboard, products with size×color×stock variants, categories, orders with statuses and auto stock adjustment, brand/shipping/WhatsApp settings, JSON/CSV migration). Read-only demo mode for risk-free testing.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Lucide. PostgreSQL on Supabase with Prisma ORM. Supabase Auth (email/password + Google OAuth) host-aware for correct redirects on custom domains. Middleware proxy for transparent rewrite customdomain.com → /[slug].
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: Production-ready system with 387 tests, clean build, zero tsc errors. Real multi-tenant working: demo-outlet live at outlet.alejandropl.com/demo-outlet. Highly resource-efficient cloud architecture engineered for scale. Architecture ready for custom domains (UI in panel pending).

PROJECTS.TITLE: Maquirent
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Web platform for heavy machinery rental and logistics management in Colombia. Enables contractors to check real-time fleet availability, calculate formal transparent quotes with Colombian tax rules (COP, SENA operator, VAT, freight), and generate legal PDF contracts instantly.

CASE_STUDY.PROBLEM: In civil construction and infrastructure, renting heavy equipment was traditionally handled through informal, manual calls and spreadsheets. This led to double-booking conflicts, hidden logistical fees, delayed approvals, and days wasted preparing legal rental agreements.
CASE_STUDY.SOLUTION: Built Maquirent: an end-to-end web platform that digitalizes heavy machinery leasing. Features a real-time availability catalog with overlap prevention, a transparent COP pricing engine (19% VAT, SENA-certified operator, security deposit, on-site freight), generation of formal PDF contracts, and dedicated portals for both customers and administrators with key metrics and one-click WhatsApp contact.
CASE_STUDY.ARCHITECTURE: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui. Backend with Route Handlers, Server Actions, and NextAuth.js v5 for role-based access control (ADMIN / CLIENT). PostgreSQL database with Prisma ORM v7. PDF generation and schema validation via Zod.
CASE_STUDY.RESULTS: Instant formal quotes with tax breakdown and reduction of contract issuance time from hours to seconds.
